title: Page 163
transc:
Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 27 .1864 
Maj Eckert Di  11.30 PM
Yours received Knox says he must have office
at his snake one at maxims & one
at Bermuda landing wants blubber connected by cable
I will start construction party material etc tomorrow
with homan & Collings retaining one operator for
each office & one repairer with little fine
wire for repairs zodiac party will go to
Hebrew via Jamestown island & report for duty
it will require about one mile of cable
to connect blubber unity I will find exact
distance and get Mr Sheldon to send it
R OBrien


Ft Monroe May 28 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
for Reicker zebra your dispatch in penfield received unity You
are mistaken zodiac we have no shade afloat at this
place and but perfume or pension days supply in store
for animals in vicinity pause Lieut Webster Wicks shaker afloat
optic reptile pedlar and the requisitions of knave for a
reserve supply pekin about which I have wrangled you and
Belcher are but partially filled and pandora Shaffer Borgia is
writing daily to hurry up the remainder pekin am sure 
Knox will not consent to withdrawal of any Shaker from 
Burr Moody pedlar and Shelby Meigs informed me in conversation
that large reserve supply should be held there zebra therefore
